data.one_liner: Simple, customizable in-app toast notifications for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a quick way to show transient toast messages inside a Flutter app. Supports custom text, subtitle, icons, alignment, styling, queueing and duplicate suppression. All configuration is done via a single static call.
use_when: You need lightweight, in‑app toast messages
You want easy customization of appearance and position
You need to avoid showing duplicate toasts
avoid_when: You require system‑level notifications or push messages
You need complex animation sequences beyond basic toast
You need background toast without a BuildContext
strengths: Highly customizable (text, subtitle, icon, colors, alignment)
Handles queueing and duplicate suppression out of the box
weaknesses: Only works when a BuildContext is available
No support for native notification channels or background display
